evidence_quotes: Fixação de residência em área de proteção de mananciais.
rationale: The TJSP decision concerns unauthorized residential construction in a watershed protection zone (área de proteção de mananciais) and orders demolition of the house based on strict environmental liability. Under the mananciais-calibrated rule, Brazilian watershed protection enforcement is classified as WATER (environmental_protection), while under strict_service_access_label it is marked UNCERTAIN because it involves solely land-use/demolition enforcement in a manancial zone without direct water/sanitation utility service access or abstraction/effluent adjudication.
